## 2. Print stream and bar kernel: vsess_200 (session-volume clock) on _CANC prints
Code: code/th_bars/kernels.py:10-33 `k_cum` mode 0; built at code/th_bars/build_month.py:96 with threshold `np.maximum(svol/p, 1.0)`, p = 200 (see D8_ASIA_NEWBOOK_INPUTS.md section 1b for the same rule on Asia); print rule: D8_PRINT_RULE.md sections 1 and 4 (run merge, quote-rule side, known = next different print's stamp) exactly as D8_NYAM_SPEC_B7bfd33b7.md section 2 steps 1-2.
- Threshold (contracts, float, constant for the whole London session of a trading date) = max(S / 200, 1) with S = the MEDIAN of the London-session volumes (session code 1: every record of ET 02:00-08:30, contracts) of the 20 stats rows BEFORE the td (current day never used; London volumes missing or <= 0 dropped; at least 5 values; then back/forward fill) (build_month.py:23-31). Table in section 6.
- Bar: opens at the first print of the London session (the first merged print at/after 02:00:00 ET); each print adds its merged size; closes at the first print where cumulative volume >= threshold (>=); the closing print stays whole in the bar (overshoot not carried); next bar starts at 0 with the next print; o = first print price, h/l extremes, c = closing print price; known time = stamp of the closing print; the open remainder at 08:30 ET is emitted with part = 1 (known = last record) and cannot signal.
- Session of a bar = key sess_id = td x 10 + 1; state resets at the session key change.
- VERIFIED: td 20261027 (EDT, session 06:00-12:30Z, 58,315 records -> 51,661 prints, thr 316.258): 231 bars; td 20261110 (EST, 07:00-13:30Z, 43,160 records -> 37,400 prints, thr 348.670): 167 bars; all columns equal the stored CANC bars. A rebuild with the exchange aggressor flag instead of the quote-rule side also gave the identical bars on 1110.

## 3. Trigger: trig_xmarket_rates, variant with_ZB, w 5, thr 1.0 (exact rule)
Code: code/th_grid/triggers_d/xm_rates.py (SYMS ZN, ZB; DATA_NEED "ZN / ZB 1-minute bars real time"), xm_base.py:64-72 `make_own` (variant split `with_ZB`), fd_xm.py:10-47 (feature build: r = close/close(w minutes earlier) - 1, id clean, rolling std), fd_common.py edge. Independent copy: my numpy implementation on the same files.
1. Series: Databento ohlcv-1m of ZB (CBOT 30-year Treasury, continuous front month; /mnt/l2/l2vast/_alpha_breadth/ZB_1m.parquet, ts_event = minute START, instrument_id kept) on the same dense 1-minute grid as the NQ minute store (first minute 2023-04-02 22:00 UTC); a missing minute is NaN. A minute is KNOWN at start + 60 s.
2. For a bar with known time T (whole seconds floor, T = THIS bar's own known time; NOT the previous bar's, unlike the level books): minute index k = floor(T / 60) - 1 (the last completed minute; example bar known 07:41:34.285Z uses the minute starting 07:40:00Z).
3. r5 = ZB close(k) / ZB close(k-5) - 1 (float32); NaN if either close is missing, k < 5, or the instrument id changed anywhere inside the 5-minute window (ids forward-filled over gaps; fd_xm.py:22-26 `idclean`).
4. sigma = sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of r5 itself over the 4,320 grid positions before minute k (rolling window ending at k-1, current excluded, valid values only, at least 600 else NaN) (fd_xm.py:27-28). z = r5 / sigma; NaN counts 0 at the bar.
5. UP = z >= +1.0, DOWN = z <= -1.0 (inclusive), each an EDGE (true now, false on the previous bar of the series; one continuous series of ALL sessions; first bar False).
6. WITH: LONG on the UP edge (ZB rising: NQ follows), SHORT on the DOWN edge; both on one bar -> dropped. Sides both. Signal bar must be code 1, part = 0.
VERIFIED: engine module (CANC bars) = events 20,472 / 20,472; my numpy rule = 20,472 / 20,472; my z = engine zown5 (all 1,902,240 grid minutes, atol 1e-5).

## 4. Data NT8 needs
NQ trades with the quote-rule side (bid/ask at each trade, D8_PRINT_RULE.md) to build the run-merged prints; ZB completed 1-minute closes with the ZB instrument id (roll flag) and 4,320 grid minutes (3 days) of history for sigma; the NQ minute store is NOT needed (z is the ZB move itself). The ZB file on the box ends 2026-11-10 07:58Z: no ZB parity is possible after that and the live feed is OPEN. ZB calendar front-month (Databento) versus NT8 continuous contract roll: OPEN.

## 5. Bracket, sides, window, one position
- Bracket: stop 120.0 / target 60.0 points from the entry fill, fixed, 1 lot, no unit rule. Sides both. Window: London bars (ET 02:00-08:30); exit at 08:30 ET + 1 s.
**Signal to engine event (VERIFIED in code).** Event time = floor(known time of the signal bar to whole seconds) + 2 s (code/th_brkt/brkt_build.py:42 / th_nyeng/ny_build.py:32); events with ts >= the session-end instant are dropped (brkt_build.py:46); session-end instant = next ET boundary after the signal bar (code/th_swap/common.py:32-40; London = 08:30 ET: 13:30:00Z in EST, 12:30:00Z in EDT); exit cap N = 120 s (code/th_fakefill/cap_exit.py). Only bars of session code 1 (ET 02:00-08:30; code/th_swap/common.py:41-44) with part = 0 can signal. **One-position / fill / exits (text of D8_BUILD_SPEC.md (b2), simulator code/replica/sim.py, NOT re-verified here).** MARKET order at event time, filled 1.0 s later walking the 10-level book; stop = stop order at fill -/+ 120 pts, target = resting limit at fill +/- 60 pts; ONE position per book (an event while in a trade / exit pending / entry in flight is dropped); scheduled exit at 08:30 ET + 1.0 s (120 s last-print rule); roll: flat 1 ns before the roll second, entries skipped roll-120 s to roll+300 s. 1 lot per book in the engine runs (bare R0).
